title: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate (AI-200) Complete
description: Prepares you for Microsoft Exam AI-200 (Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure) and the Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate certification. Follows the four skill domains of the official study guide, with Python-first examples, vector search on Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL and Redis, and links to the official Microsoft Learn documentation.
benefits: Build, version and run container images with Azure Container Registry, ACR Tasks and App Service
Deploy to Azure Container Apps with revisions and KEDA event-driven scaling, and to AKS with manifest files
Query Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL, tune RUs with indexing policies and choose a consistency level
Store embeddings and run vector similarity search on Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL (pgvector) and Azure Managed Redis
Implement a change feed processor, RAG retrieval with metadata filters, and cache-aside with expiration
Process messages with Service Bus (dead-letter queues, topics) and react to events with Event Grid (filters, retries)
Build serverless APIs with Azure Functions triggers and bindings, and deploy function apps
Secure secrets with Key Vault rotation and App Configuration, and trace and analyze systems with OpenTelemetry and KQL
